title: Among patients with a normal anti-scl70 level and no recorded symptoms, fin
question: Among patients with a normal anti-scl70 level and no recorded symptoms, find those whose IgA is within the normal range. From this group, return the top 5 patients with the highest IgA values, showing their ID, sex, diagnosis, and IgA level.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS ID,
    p.XCL_059 AS sex,
    p.XCL_064 AS diagnosis,
    l.XCL_043 AS IgA_level
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
WHERE l.XCL_051 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND e.XCL_012 IS NULL
  AND l.XCL_043 BETWEEN 70 AND 400
ORDER BY l.XCL_043 DESC
LIMIT 5
